projects.name: Armani Hallson Bukit Bintang
projects.address: Jalan Pavilion, Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur
projects.priceNote: Exclusive entry price. 4% Market Profit Assurance* applies. *Terms & conditions apply.
projects.description:
Armani Hallson Bukit Bintang is a freehold, ultra-luxury high-rise on Jalan Pavilion, in the heart of Bukit Bintang. It is the next chapter after Armani Hallson KLCC, which launched in 2025.

The design brings the calm of a forest setting into one of Kuala Lumpur's busiest districts. Residents live next to Jalan Alor Food Street and within walking distance of Pavilion KL, Lalaport BBCC and the LRT, MRT and Monorail.

Selected units come fully furnished, with interiors by the award-winning Matthew Lim Associates. Finishes include travertine stone kitchen countertops, gunmetal bathroom fittings, ceiling rain showers and, in selected units, a private jacuzzi.
projects.highlights:
Freehold address in Kuala Lumpur's Golden Triangle
On Jalan Pavilion, next to Jalan Alor Food Street
Walk to Pavilion KL, Lalaport BBCC and the Bukit Bintang crosswalk
LRT, MRT and Monorail stations nearby
Sky facilities on Levels 69 to 73 with KLCC and KL Tower views
Selected units fully furnished, some with a private jacuzzi
Interiors by award-winning Matthew Lim Associates
Targeting GreenRE Gold, with rooftop solar panels
